    ≡⟨ zipWithcomm (ℚ._+_) +comm (datavec t1) (datavec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t2) (datavec t1) ∎

theoremtensoraddassoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_add t1 t2) t3) ≡
  datavec (tensor_add t1 (tensor_add t2 t3))
theoremtensoraddassoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2)) (datavec t3)
    ≡⟨ zipWithassoc (ℚ._+_) +assoc (datavec t1) (datavec t2) (datavec t3) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t2) (datavec t3)) ∎

zipWithreplicateleft : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ x → f z x ≡ x) →
  zipWith f (replicate z) v ≡ v
zipWithreplicateleft {zero} f z [] leftid = refl
zipWithreplicateleft {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) leftid = cong₂ _∷_ (leftid x) (zipWithreplicateleft f z xs leftid)

theoremtensoraddzeroleft : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroleft {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ cong (λ v → zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (datavec t)) refl ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (replicate 0ℚ) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ zipWithreplicateleft (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (datavec t) (proj₁ +identity) ⟩
  datavec t ∎

theoremtensoraddzeroright : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroright {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  datavec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype))
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddcomm t (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ⟩
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t)
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddzeroleft t ⟩
  datavec t ∎

mapzipWithdistributive : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ) (g : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f (g x y) ≡ g (f x) (f y)) →
  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
mapzipWithdistributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
mapzipWithdistributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = 
  cong₂ _∷_ (dist x y) (mapzipWithdistributive f g dist xs ys)

theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s (tensor_add t1 t2)) ≡
  datavec (tensor_add (tensorscalarmul s t1) (tensorscalarmul s t2))
theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s  x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2))
    ≡⟨ mapzipWithdistributive (λ x → s  x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → distribʳ+ s x y) (datavec t1) (datavec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t1)) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t2)) ∎

mapcong : ∀ {n} {f g :p : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v
mapcong {zero} eq [] = refl
mapcong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (mapcong eq xs)

theoremtensorscalarmulassociative : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s1 s2 : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s1 (tensorscalarmul s2 t)) ≡
  datavec (tensorscalarmul (s1  s2) t)
theoremtensorscalarmulassociative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1  x) (map (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map∘ (λ x → s1  x) (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1  x) ∘ (λ x → s2  x)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ mapcong (λ x → assoc s1 s2 x) (datavec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1  s2)  x) (datavec t) ∎

rationalexpiter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalexpiter zero k acc term x = acc
rationalexpiter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rationalexpiter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term  x / fromℕ (suc k)) x

rationalexp : ℚ → ℚ
rationalexp x = rationalexpiter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rationalsqrtiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrtiter zero x guess = guess
rationalsqrtiter (suc n) x guess = rationalsqrtiter n x ((guess + x / guess)  ½)

rationalsqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrt x = rationalsqrtiter 10 x 1ℚ

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation Tanh x = (rationalexp x  rationalexp ( x)) / (rationalexp x + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation GELU x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000  x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ

... | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ

... | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor_map rationalexp t
      s = tensor_sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤ ? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shapesize sh

    invN : ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ / fromℕ (suc k)

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { datavec = replicate {n = n} invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensor_map (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t
tensorapplyactivation f t = tensor_map (applyactivation f) t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤ ? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥elim (¬y<0 (≰⇒< ¬0≤y))
  where
    ≰⇒< : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
    ≰⇒< {a} {b} ¬a≤b with a ≤ ? b | b < ? a
    ... | yes a≤b | _ = ⊥elim (¬a≤b a≤b)
    ... | no _ | yes b<a = b<a
    ... | no ¬a≤b | no ¬b<a = ⊥elim (¬a≤b (≮⇒≥ ¬b<a))
      where
        ≮⇒≥ : ∀ {x y : ℚ} → ¬ (x < y) → y ≤ x
        ≮⇒≥ {x} {y} ¬x<y with y ≤ ? x
        ... | yes y≤x = y≤x
        ... | no ¬y≤x = ⊥elim (¬x<y (≰⇒<' ¬y≤x))
          where
            ≰⇒<' : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
            ≰⇒<' = ≰⇒<

relunonneghelper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relunonneghelper x with decToBool (x < 0ℚ)
... | true = ≤refl

tensornormalize {sh} normtype eps t = normalizedtensor
  where
    μ : ℚ

rationallogiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationallogiter zero x z term = z
rationallogiter (suc n) x z term = rationallogiter n x (z + term) ( term  x  fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rationallog : ℚ → ℚ
rationallog x = rationallogiter 15 (x  1ℚ) 0ℚ (x  1ℚ)

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target = mseloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff

    sumsquared = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mseloss = sumsquared / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = celoss
  where
    logpred : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    logpred = map rationallog (datavec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec target) logpred

    celoss : ℚ
    celoss =  (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

computeloss {sh} Hinge pred target = hingeloss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ  t  p) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hingeloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = klloss
  where
    klterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    klterms = zipWith (λ t p → t  rationallog (t / p)) (datavec target) (datavec pred)

    klloss : ℚ
    klloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ klterms

computeloss {sh} MAE pred target = maeloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    maeloss : ℚ
    maeloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huberloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    huberterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    huberterms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤ ? δ) then ½  a  a else δ  (a  ½  δ)) absdiff

    huberloss : ℚ
    huberloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huberterms / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

x²nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ x  x
x²nonneg x with totalOrder x 0ℚ
... | tri< _ _ _ = x²nonneg ( x)
... | tri≈ _ _ _ = ≤refl
... | tri> x>0 _ _ = monoʳ≤nonneg x x>0 (x≥0⇒0≤x x) 
  where
    x≥0⇒0≤x : ∀ {x} → 0ℚ ≤ x → 0ℚ ≤ x
    x≥0⇒0≤x {x} 0≤x = 0≤x

    x>0⇒0≤x : ∀ {x} → 0ℚ < x → 0ℚ ≤ x
    x>0⇒≤ {x} (0ℚ <x) = <to≤ 0<x

theoremmsenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
theoremmsenonnegative {sh} pred target = begin
  computeloss MSE pred target
    ≡⟨⟩ (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) (zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) / fromℕ (shapesize sh)
    ≡⟨ /preserves≤ (foldr+nonneg (map²nonneg (zipWith (λ p t → p  t) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) (pos (fromℕ (shapesize sh))) ⟩
  0ℚ ∎
  where
    open import Data.Rational.Properties using (≤total; ≤antisym; nonnegative; <trans; <to≤; +preserves≤)
    
    pos : ∀ {n} → 0 < fromℕ n
    pos {zero} = z≤n
    pos {suc n} = s≤s z≤n

    map²nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → ∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x  x
    map²nonneg [] ()
    map²nonneg (x ∷ xs) (here refl) = x²nonneg x
    map²nonneg (x ∷ xs) (there p) = map²nonneg xs p

    foldr+nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    foldr+nonneg [] hyp = z≤n
    foldr+nonneg (x ∷ xs) hyp = ≤trans (hyp x (here refl)) (foldr+nonneg xs (λ y y∈xs → hyp y (there y∈xs)))

theoremmaenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
theoremmaenonnegative {sh} pred target = begin
  computeloss MAE pred target
    ≡⟨⟩ (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map absapprox (zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) / fromℚ (shapesize sh)
    ≡⟨ /preserves≤ (foldr+nonneg (mapabsapproxnonneg (zipWith (λ p t → p  t) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) (pos (fromℕ (shapesize sh))) ⟩
  0ℚ ∎
  where
    pos : ∀ {n} → 0 < fromℕ n
    pos {zero} = z≤n
    pos {suc n} = s≤s z≤n
    
    mapabsapproxnonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x)
    mapabsapproxnonneg [] ()
    mapabsapproxnonneg (x ∷ xs) (here refl) = absapproxnonneg x
    mapabsapproxnonneg (x ∷ xs) (there p) = mapabsapproxnonneg xs p

    absapproxnonneg : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x
    absapproxnonneg x with x < ? 0ℚ
    ... | yes x<0 = ≤refl
    ... | no ¬x<0 = x≮0⇒0≤x x ¬x<0

    foldr+nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    foldr+nonneg [] hyp = z≤n
    foldr+nonneg (x ∷ xs) hyp = ≤trans (hyp x (here refl)) (foldr+nonneg xs (λ y y∈xs → hyp y (there y∈xs)))

data OptimizerType : Set where

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)

    momentum2 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shapesize sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g → p  lr  g) (datavec params) grad
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
  in newparams , state

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β  v_i + (1ℚ  β)  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p  lr  v_i) (datavec params) newv
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { velocity = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      newm = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1  m_i + (1ℚ  β1)  g_i) m grad
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2  v_i + (1ℚ  β2)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      mhat = map (λ m_i → m_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β1  fromℕ (suc t)))) newm
      vhat = map (λ v_i → v_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β2  fromℚ (suc t)))) newv
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p  lr  m_i) (datavec params) 
                         (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) mhat vhat)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum1 = newm ; momentum2 = newv ; timestep = suc t }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α  v_i + (1ℚ  α)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → v_i + g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

theoremtensorzeroiszero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (i : Fin (shapesize Shape)) →

tensor_add : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_add = tensor_zipWith (ℚ._+_)

theoremtensoraddcomm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add t1 t2) ≡ datavec (tensor_add t2 t1)
theoremtensoraddcomm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2)
    ≡⟨ zipWithcomm (ℚ._+_) +comm (datavec t1) (datavec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t2) (datavec t1) ∎

theoremtensoraddassoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_add t1 t2) t3) ≡
  datavec (tensor_add t1 (tensor_add t2 t3))
theoremtensoraddassoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2)) (datavec t3)
    ≡⟨ zipWithassoc (ℚ._+_) +assoc (datavec t1) (datavec t2) (datavec t3) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t2) (datavec t3)) ∎

zipWithreplicateleft : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ x → f z x ≡ x) →
  zipWith f (replicate z) v ≡ v
zipWithreplicateleft {zero} f z [] leftid = refl
zipWithreplicateleft {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) leftid = cong₂ _∷_ (leftid x) (zipWithreplicateleft f z xs leftid)

theoremtensoraddzeroleft : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroleft {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ cong (λ v → zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (datavec t)) refl ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (replicate 0ℚ) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ zipWithreplicateleft (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (datavec t) (proj₁ +identity) ⟩
  datavec t ∎

theoremtensoraddzeroright : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ datavec t
theoremtensoraddzeroright {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  datavec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype))
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddcomm t (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ⟩
  datavec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t)
    ≡⟨ theoremtensoraddzeroleft t ⟩
  datavec t ∎

tensor_mul = tensor_zipWith (ℚ.__)

theoremtensormulcomm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

theoremtensormulcomm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 =

theoremtensormulassoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

tensorscalarmul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype →

tensorscalarmul scalar t = tensor_map (λ x → scalar  x) t

mapzipWithdistributive : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ) (g : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f (g x y) ≡ g (f x) (f y)) →
  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
mapzipWithdistributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
mapzipWithdistributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = 
  cong₂ _∷_ (dist x y) (mapzipWithdistributive f g dist xs ys)

theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s (tensor_add t1 t2)) ≡
  datavec (tensor_add (tensorscalarmul s t1) (tensorscalarmul s t2))
theoremtensorscalarmuldistributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s  x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (datavec t1) (datavec t2))
    ≡⟨ mapzipWithdistributive (λ x → s  x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → distribʳ+ s x y) (datavec t1) (datavec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t1)) (map (λ x → s  x) (datavec t2)) ∎

mapcong : ∀ {n} {f g :p : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v
mapcong {zero} eq [] = refl
mapcong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (mapcong eq xs)

theoremtensorscalarmulassociative : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s1 s2 : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  datavec (tensorscalarmul s1 (tensorscalarmul s2 t)) ≡
  datavec (tensorscalarmul (s1  s2) t)
theoremtensorscalarmulassociative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1  x) (map (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map∘ (λ x → s1  x) (λ x → s2  x) (datavec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1  x) ∘ (λ x → s2  x)) (datavec t)
    ≡⟨ mapcong (λ x → assoc s1 s2 x) (datavec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1  s2)  x) (datavec t) ∎

tensor_sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

tensor_sum = tensor_fold (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ

foldrreplicate : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z x : ℚ) →
  (∀ y → f z y ≡ y) →
  foldr f z (replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldrreplicate {zero} f z x id = refl
foldrreplicate {suc n} f z x id = trans (cong (f x) (foldrreplicate f z x id)) (id z)

theoremtensorsumzero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction

rationalexpiter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalexpiter zero k acc term x = acc
rationalexpiter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rationalexpiter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term  x / fromℕ (suc k)) x

rationalexp : ℚ → ℚ
rationalexp x = rationalexpiter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rationalsqrtiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrtiter zero x guess = guess
rationalsqrtiter (suc n) x guess = rationalsqrtiter n x ((guess + x / guess)  ½)

rationalsqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rationalsqrt x = rationalsqrtiter 10 x 1ℚ

applyactivation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
applyactivation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation Tanh x = (rationalexp x  rationalexp ( x)) / (rationalexp x + rationalexp ( x))
applyactivation GELU x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000  x)
applyactivation Softmax x = x
applyactivation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  x
... | no _ = x
applyactivation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α  (rationalexp x  1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
applyactivation Swish x = x  applyactivation Sigmoid x

tensorsoftmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorsoftmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor_map rationalexp t
      s = tensor_sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤ ? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shapesize sh

    invN : ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ / fromℕ (suc k)

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { datavec = replicate {n = n} invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensor_map (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensorapplyactivation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensorapplyactivation Softmax t = tensorsoftmax t
tensorapplyactivation f t = tensor_map (applyactivation f) t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤ ? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥elim (¬y<0 (≰⇒< ¬0≤y))
  where
    ≰⇒< : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
    ≰⇒< {a} {b} ¬a≤b with a ≤ ? b | b < ? a
    ... | yes a≤b | _ = ⊥elim (¬a≤b a≤b)
    ... | no _ | yes b<a = b<a
    ... | no ¬a≤b | no ¬b<a = ⊥elim (¬a≤b (≮⇒≥ ¬b<a))
      where
        ≮⇒≥ : ∀ {x y : ℚ} → ¬ (x < y) → y ≤ x
        ≮⇒≥ {x} {y} ¬x<y with y ≤ ? x
        ... | yes y≤x = y≤x
        ... | no ¬y≤x = ⊥elim (¬x<y (≰⇒<' ¬y≤x))
          where
            ≰⇒<' : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
            ≰⇒<' = ≰⇒<

relunonneghelper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relunonneghelper x with decToBool (x < 0ℚ)
... | true = ≤refl
... | false = x≮0≤x x (λ ())

theoremrelunonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

tensornormalize : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensornormalize {sh} normtype eps t = normalizedtensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensor_sum t / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x  μ) (datavec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) centered) / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rationalsqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x / (std + eps)) centered

    normalizedtensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalizedtensor = record t { datavec = normalized }

absapprox x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ =  x

theoremnormalizationzeromean : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

... | yes bound = bound
... | no _ = ≤refl

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rationallogiter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rationallogiter zero x z term = z
rationallogiter (suc n) x z term = rationallogiter n x (z + term) ( term  x  fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rationallog : ℚ → ℚ
rationallog x = rationallogiter 15 (x  1ℚ) 0ℚ (x  1ℚ)

computeloss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
computeloss {sh} MSE pred target = mseloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x  x) diff

    sumsquared : ℚ
    sumsquared = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mseloss : ℚ
    mseloss = sumsquared / fromℕ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = celoss
  where
    logpred : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    logpred = map rationallog (datavec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec target) logpred

    celoss : ℚ
    celoss =  (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

computeloss {sh} Hinge pred target = hingeloss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ  t  p) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hingeloss : ℚ
    hingeloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = klloss
  where
    klterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    klterms = zipWith (λ t p → t  rationallog (t / p)) (datavec target) (datavec pred)

    klloss : ℚ
    klloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ klterms

computeloss {sh} MAE pred target = maeloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    maeloss : ℚ
    maeloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ absdiff / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

computeloss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huberloss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)

    absdiff : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    absdiff = map absapprox diff

    huberterms : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    huberterms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤ ? δ) then ½  a  a else δ  (a  ½  δ)) absdiff

    huberloss : ℚ
    huberloss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huberterms / fromℚ (shapesize sh)

x²nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ x  x
x²nonneg x with totalOrder x 0ℚ
... | tri< _ _ _ = x²nonneg ( x)
... | tri≈ _ _ _ = ≤refl
... | tri> x>0 _ _ = monoʳ≤nonneg x x>0 (x≥0⇒0≤x x) 
  where
    x≥0⇒0≤x : ∀ {x} → 0ℚ ≤ x → 0ℚ ≤ x
    x≥0⇒0≤x {x} 0≤x = 0≤x

    x>0⇒0≤x : ∀ {x} → 0ℚ < x → 0ℚ ≤ x
    x>0⇒≤ {x} (0ℚ <x) = <to≤ 0<x

theoremmsenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MSE pred target
theoremmsenonnegative {sh} pred target = begin
  computeloss MSE pred target
    ≡⟨⟩ (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x  x) (zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) / fromℕ (shapesize sh)
    ≡⟨ /preserves≤ (foldr+nonneg (map²nonneg (zipWith (λ p t → p  t) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) (pos (fromℕ (shapesize sh))) ⟩
  0ℚ ∎
  where
    open import Data.Rational.Properties using (≤total; ≤antisym; nonnegative; <trans; <to≤; +preserves≤)
    
    pos : ∀ {n} → 0 < fromℕ n
    pos {zero} = z≤n
    pos {suc n} = s≤s z≤n

    map²nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → ∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x  x
    map²nonneg [] ()
    map²nonneg (x ∷ xs) (here refl) = x²nonneg x
    map²nonneg (x ∷ xs) (there p) = map²nonneg xs p

    foldr+nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    foldr+nonneg [] hyp = z≤n
    foldr+nonneg (x ∷ xs) hyp = ≤trans (hyp x (here refl)) (foldr+nonneg xs (λ y y∈xs → hyp y (there y∈xs)))

theoremmaenonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ computeloss MAE pred target
theoremmaenonnegative {sh} pred target = begin
  computeloss MAE pred target
    ≡⟨⟩ (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map absapprox (zipWith (ℚ.__) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) / fromℚ (shapesize sh)
    ≡⟨ /preserves≤ (foldr+nonneg (mapabsapproxnonneg (zipWith (λ p t → p  t) (datavec pred) (datavec target)))) (pos (fromℕ (shapesize sh))) ⟩
  0ℚ ∎
  where
    pos : ∀ {n} → 0 < fromℕ n
    pos {zero} = z≤n
    pos {suc n} = s≤s z≤n
    
    mapabsapproxnonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x)
    mapabsapproxnonneg [] ()
    mapabsapproxnonneg (x ∷ xs) (here refl) = absapproxnonneg x
    mapabsapproxnonneg (x ∷ xs) (there p) = mapabsapproxnonneg xs p

    absapproxnonneg : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ absapprox x
    absapproxnonneg x with x < ? 0ℚ
    ... | yes x<0 = ≤refl
    ... | no ¬x<0 = x≮0⇒0≤x x ¬x<0

    foldr+nonneg : ∀ {n} (v : Vec ℚ n) → (∀ x → x ∈ v → 0ℚ ≤ x) → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    foldr+nonneg [] hyp = z≤n
    foldr+nonneg (x ∷ xs) hyp = ≤trans (hyp x (here refl)) (foldr+nonneg xs (λ y y∈xs → hyp y (there y∈xs)))

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum1 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    momentum2 : Vec ℚ (shapesize sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initialoptimizerstate : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initialoptimizerstate sh = mkOptimizerState 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  0

applyoptimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shapesize sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g → p  lr  g) (datavec params) grad
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
  in newparams , state

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β  v_i + (1ℚ  β)  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p  lr  v_i) (datavec params) newv
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { velocity = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      newm = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1  m_i + (1ℚ  β1)  g_i) m grad
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2  v_i + (1ℚ  β2)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      mhat = map (λ m_i → m_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β1  fromℕ (suc t)))) newm
      vhat = map (λ v_i → v_i / (1ℚ  rationalexp (rationallog β2  fromℚ (suc t)))) newv
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p  lr  m_i) (datavec params) 
                         (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) mhat vhat)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum1 = newm ; momentum2 = newv ; timestep = suc t }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      newv = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α  v_i + (1ℚ  α)  g_i  g_i) v grad
      newparamsvec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p  lr  g_i) (datavec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rationalsqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad newv)
      newparams = record params { datavec = newparamsvec }
      newstate = record state { momentum2 = newv }
  in newparams , newstate

applyoptimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =

lemma-shape-size-cons-positive zero s () q
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive (suc d) s (s≤s z≤n) q = m≤m+n (shape-size s) (d * shape-size s)

lemma-shape-size-append-positive : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → NoZero s1 → NoZero s2 → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-append-positive s1 s2 q r = m≤m+n (shape-size s1) (shape-size s1 * (shape-size s2 ∸ 1))

tensor_map f t = record t { data-vec = map f (data-vec t) }

tensor_map-preserves-shape : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  length (toList (data-vec (tensor_map f t))) ≡ shape-size Shape
tensor_map-preserves-shape f t = shape-consistency (tensor_map f t)

tensor_map-id : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor_map id t ≡ record t { data-vec = data-vec t }
tensor_map-id t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (map-id (data-vec t))

tensor_map-compose : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f g : ℚ → ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  tensor_map (f ∘ g) t ≡ tensor_map f (tensor_map g t)
tensor_map-compose f g t = cong (λ v → record t { data-vec = v }) (sym (map-∘ f g (data-vec t)))

tensor_zipWith : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_zipWith f t1 t2 = record t1 { data-vec = zipWith f (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) }

tensor_zipWith-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f x y ≡ f y x) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_zipWith f t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor_zipWith f t2 t1)
tensor_zipWith-comm f f-comm t1 t2 = zipWith-comm f f-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)

  ℚ →

tensor_fold-cons : ∀ {n : ℕ} {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (z : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  (x : ℚ) →
  (xs : Vec ℚ n) →
  data-vec t ≡ x ∷ xs →
  tensor_fold f z t ≡ f x (foldr f z xs)
tensor_fold-cons f z t x xs prf = cong (foldr f z) prf

tensor_replicate : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_replicate Shape dtype v = mkTensor (replicate v) ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

theorem-tensor-replicate-all-equal : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (v : ℚ) →
  (i j : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_replicate Shape dtype v)) ≡
  lookup j (data-vec (tensor_replicate Shape dtype v))
theorem-tensor-replicate-all-equal Shape dtype v i j = 
  trans (lookup-replicate i v) (sym (lookup-replicate j v))

theorem-tensor-replicate-value : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (v : ℚ) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_replicate Shape dtype v)) ≡ v
theorem-tensor-replicate-value Shape dtype v i = lookup-replicate i v

tensor_zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_zero Shape dtype = tensor_replicate Shape dtype 0ℚ

theorem-tensor-zero-is-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-zero-is-zero Shape dtype i = lookup-replicate i 0ℚ

tensor_one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_one Shape dtype = tensor_replicate Shape dtype 1ℚ

theorem-tensor-one-is-one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_one Shape dtype)) ≡ 1ℚ
theorem-tensor-one-is-one Shape dtype i = lookup-replicate i 1ℚ

tensor_add : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_add = tensor_zipWith (ℚ._+_)

theorem-tensor-add-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor_add t2 t1)
theorem-tensor-add-comm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-comm (ℚ._+_) +-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t1) ∎

theorem-tensor-add-assoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_add t1 t2) t3) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_add t1 (tensor_add t2 t3))
theorem-tensor-add-assoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)) (data-vec t3)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-assoc (ℚ._+_) +-assoc (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3)) ∎

zipWith-replicate-left : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ x → f z x ≡ x) →
  zipWith f (replicate z) v ≡ v
zipWith-replicate-left {zero} f z [] left-id = refl
zipWith-replicate-left {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) left-id = cong₂ _∷_ (left-id x) (zipWith-replicate-left f z xs left-id)

theorem-tensor-add-zero-left : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t) ≡ data-vec t
theorem-tensor-add-zero-left {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ cong (λ v → zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (data-vec t)) refl ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (replicate 0ℚ) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-replicate-left (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (data-vec t) (proj₁ +-identity) ⟩
  data-vec t ∎

theorem-tensor-add-zero-right : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ data-vec t
theorem-tensor-add-zero-right {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  data-vec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype))
    ≡⟨ theorem-tensor-add-comm t (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ⟩
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t)
    ≡⟨ theorem-tensor-add-zero-left t ⟩
  data-vec t ∎

tensor_mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_mul = tensor_zipWith (ℚ._*_)

theorem-tensor-mul-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_mul t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor_mul t2 t1)
theorem-tensor-mul-comm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = 
  zipWith-comm (ℚ._*_) *-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)

theorem-tensor-mul-assoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_mul (tensor_mul t1 t2) t3) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_mul t1 (tensor_mul t2 t3))
theorem-tensor-mul-assoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = 
  zipWith-assoc (ℚ._*_) *-assoc (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3)

tensor-scalar-mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-scalar-mul scalar t = tensor_map (λ x → scalar ℚ.* x) t

map-zipWith-distributive : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ) (g : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f (g x y) ≡ g (f x) (f y)) →
  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
map-zipWith-distributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
map-zipWith-distributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = 
  cong₂ _∷_ (dist x y) (map-zipWith-distributive f g dist xs ys)

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul s (tensor_add t1 t2)) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor-scalar-mul s t1) (tensor-scalar-mul s t2))
theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s ℚ.* x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2))
    ≡⟨ map-zipWith-distributive (λ x → s ℚ.* x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → *-distribʳ-+ s x y) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s ℚ.* x) (data-vec t1)) (map (λ x → s ℚ.* x) (data-vec t2)) ∎

map-cong : ∀ {n} {f g : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v
map-cong {zero} eq [] = refl
map-cong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (map-cong eq xs)

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-associative : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s1 s2 : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul s1 (tensor-scalar-mul s2 t)) ≡
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul (s1 ℚ.* s2) t)
theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-associative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1 ℚ.* x) (map (λ x → s2 ℚ.* x) (data-vec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map-∘ (λ x → s1 ℚ.* x) (λ x → s2 ℚ.* x) (data-vec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1 ℚ.* x) ∘ (λ x → s2 ℚ.* x)) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ map-cong (λ x → *-assoc s1 s2 x) (data-vec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1 ℚ.* s2) ℚ.* x) (data-vec t) ∎

tensor_sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  ℚ
tensor_sum = tensor_fold (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ

foldr-replicate : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z x : ℚ) →
  (∀ y → f x y ≡ y) →
  foldr f y (replicate {n = n} x) ≡ y
foldr-replicate {zero} f z x id = refl
foldr-replicate {suc n} f z x id = trans (cong (f x) (foldr-replicate f z x id)) (id z)

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  tensor_sum (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = foldr-replicate (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ 0ℚ (proj₁ +-identity)

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction
  GELU : ActivationFunction
  Softmax : ActivationFunction
  LeakyReLU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  ELU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  Swish : ActivationFunction

rational-exp-iter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp-iter zero k acc term x = acc
rational-exp-iter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rational-exp-iter n (suc k) (acc ℚ.+ term) (term ℚ.* x ℚ.÷ fromℕ (suc k)) x

rational-exp : ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp x = rational-exp-iter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rational-sqrt-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt-iter zero x guess = guess
rational-sqrt-iter (suc n) x guess = rational-sqrt-iter n x ((guess ℚ.+ x ℚ.÷ guess) ℚ.* ½)

rational-sqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt x = rational-sqrt-iter 10 x 1ℚ

_≤?_ : ℚ → ℚ → Bool
x ≤? y = decToBool (x ℚ.≤? y)

_<?_ : ℚ → ℚ → Bool
x <? y = decToBool (x ℚ.<? y)

apply-activation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
apply-activation ReLU x = if x <? 0ℚ then 0ℚ else x
apply-activation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ ℚ.÷ (1ℚ ℚ.+ rational-exp (ℚ.- x))
apply-activation Tanh x = (rational-exp x ℚ.- rational-exp (ℚ.- x)) ℚ.÷ (rational-exp x ℚ.+ rational-exp (ℚ.- x))
apply-activation GELU x = x ℚ.* apply-activation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000 ℚ.* x)
apply-activation Softmax x = x
apply-activation (LeakyReLU α) x = if x <? 0ℚ then α ℚ.* x else x
apply-activation (ELU α) x = if x <? 0ℚ then α ℚ.* (rational-exp x ℚ.- 1ℚ) else x
apply-activation Swish x = x ℚ.* apply-activation Sigmoid x

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor_map rational-exp t
      s = tensor_sum exps
  in if s ≤? 0ℚ then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shape-size sh

    invN : ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ ℚ.÷ fromℕ (suc k)

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { data-vec = replicate {n = n} invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensor_map (λ e → e ℚ.÷ denom) tt

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation Softmax t = tensor-softmax t
tensor-apply-activation f t = tensor_map (apply-activation f) t

theorem-activation-preserves-shape : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ActivationFunction) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  length (toList (data-vec (tensor-apply-activation f t))) ≡ shape-size sh
theorem-activation-preserves-shape f t = shape-consistency (tensor-apply-activation f t)

data NormalizationType : Set where
  BatchNorm : NormalizationType
  LayerNorm : NormalizationType
  InstanceNorm : NormalizationType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormalizationType

tensor-normalize : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-normalize {sh} norm-type eps t = normalized-tensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensor_sum t ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x ℚ.- μ) (data-vec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) centered) ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rational-sqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x ℚ.÷ (std ℚ.+ eps)) centered

    normalized-tensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalized-tensor = record t { data-vec = normalized }

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rational-log-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-log-iter zero x z term = z
rational-log-iter (suc n) x z term = rational-log-iter n x (z ℚ.+ term) (ℚ.- term ℚ.* x ℚ.* fromℕ n ℚ.÷ fromℕ (suc n))

rational-log : ℚ → ℚ
rational-log x = rational-log-iter 15 (x ℚ.- 1ℚ) 0ℚ (x ℚ.- 1ℚ)

abs-approx : ℚ → ℚ
abs-approx x = if x <? 0ℚ then ℚ.- x else x

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
compute-loss {sh} MSE pred target = mse-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x ℚ.* x) diff

    sum-squared : ℚ
    sum-squared = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mse-loss : ℚ
    mse-loss = sum-squared ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = ce-loss
  where
    log-pred : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    log-pred = map rational-log (data-vec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ._*_) (data-vec target) log-pred

    ce-loss : ℚ
    ce-loss = ℚ.- (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

compute-loss {sh} Hinge pred target = hinge-loss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ ℚ.- t ℚ.* p) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if x <? 0ℚ then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hinge-loss : ℚ
    hinge-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = kl-loss
  where
    kl-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    kl-terms = zipWith (λ t p → t ℚ.* rational-log (t ℚ.÷ p)) (data-vec target) (data-vec pred)

    kl-loss : ℚ
    kl-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ kl-terms

compute-loss {sh} MAE pred target = mae-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    mae-loss : ℚ
    mae-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ abs-diff ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huber-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    huber-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    huber-terms = map (λ a → if a ≤? δ then ½ ℚ.* a ℚ.* a else δ ℚ.* (a ℚ.- ½ ℚ.* δ)) abs-diff

    huber-loss : ℚ
    huber-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huber-terms ℚ.÷ fromℕ (shape-size sh)

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    momentum1 : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    momentum2 : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initial-optimizer-state : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initial-optimizer-state sh = mkOptimizerState 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  0

apply-optimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shape-size sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p g → p ℚ.- lr ℚ.* g) (data-vec params) grad
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
  in new-params , state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β ℚ.* v_i ℚ.+ (1ℚ ℚ.- β) ℚ.* g_i) v grad
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p ℚ.- lr ℚ.* v_i) (data-vec params) new-v
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { velocity = new-v }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      new-m = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1 ℚ.* m_i ℚ.+ (1ℚ ℚ.- β1) ℚ.* g_i) m grad
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2 ℚ.* v_i ℚ.+ (1ℚ ℚ.- β2) ℚ.* g_i ℚ.* g_i) v grad
      m-hat = map (λ m_i → m_i ℚ.÷ (1ℚ ℚ.- rational-exp (rational-log β1 ℚ.* fromℕ (suc t)))) new-m
      v-hat = map (λ v_i → v_i ℚ.÷ (1ℚ ℚ.- rational-exp (rational-log β2 ℚ.* fromℕ (suc t)))) new-v
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p ℚ.- lr ℚ.* m_i) (data-vec params) 
                         (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i ℚ.÷ (rational-sqrt v_i ℚ.+ mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) m-hat v-hat)
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { momentum1 = new-m ; momentum2 = new-v ; timestep = suc t }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α ℚ.* v_i ℚ.+ (1ℚ ℚ.- α) ℚ.* g_i ℚ.* g_i) v grad
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p ℚ.- lr ℚ.* g_i) (data-vec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i ℚ.÷ (rational-sqrt v_i ℚ.+ mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad new-v)
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { momentum2 = new-v }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → v_i ℚ.+ g_i ℚ.* g_i) v grad
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p ℚ.- lr ℚ.* g_i) (data-vec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i ℚ.÷ (rational-sqrt v_i ℚ.+ mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad new-v)
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { momentum2 = new-v }
  in new-params , new-state

theorem-optimizer-preserves-shape : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (opt : OptimizerType) →
  (state : OptimizerState sh) →
  (params : Tensor sh dtype) →
  (grad : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)) →
  length (toList (data-vec (proj₁ (apply-optimizer opt state params grad)))) ≡ shape-size sh
theorem-optimizer-preserves-shape opt state params grad = shape-consistency (proj₁ (apply-optimizer opt state params grad))

data InitializationType : Set where
  Xavier : InitializationType
  He : InitializationType
  LeCun : InitializationType
  Orthogonal : InitializationType

initialize-weights : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → InitializationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype
initialize-weights sh dtype Xavier seed =
  let fan-in = fromℕ (shape-size sh)
      fan-out = fromℕ (shape-size sh)
      limit = rational-sqrt (mkℚ (+ 6) 1 ℚ.÷ (fan-in ℚ.+ fan-out))
      weights = map (λ i → (fromℕ (toℕ i) ℚ.* seed) ℚ.÷ fan-in) (tabulate id)
  in mkTensor weights ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

initialize-weights sh dtype He seed =
  let fan-in = fromℕ (shape-size sh)
      std = rational-sqrt (mkℚ (+ 2) 1 ℚ.÷ fan-in)
      weights = map (λ i → std ℚ.* ((fromℕ (toℕ i) ℚ.* seed) ℚ.÷ fan-in)) (tabulate id)
  in mkTensor weights ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

initialize-weights sh dtype LeCun seed =
  let fan-in = fromℕ (shape-size sh)
      std = rational-sqrt (mkℚ (+ 1) 1 ℚ.÷ fan-in)
      weights = map (λ i → std ℚ.* ((fromℕ (toℕ i) ℚ.* seed) ℚ.÷ fan-in)) (tabulate id)
  in mkTensor weights ROW_MAJOR CPU OWNED 1

initialize-weights sh dtype Orthogonal seed =
  tensor_replicate sh dtype seed

theorem-initialization-shape : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (init : InitializationType) (seed : ℚ) →
  length (toList (data-vec (initialize-weights sh dtype init seed))) ≡ shape-size sh
theorem-initialization-shape sh dtype init seed = shape-consistency (initialize-weights sh dtype init seed)

data RegularizationType : Set where
  L1 : ℚ → RegularizationType
  L2 : ℚ → RegularizationType
  Dropout : ℚ → RegularizationType
  ElasticNet : ℚ → ℚ → RegularizationType

apply-regularization : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  RegularizationType →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
apply-regularization {sh} (L1 λ) params = map (λ w → λ ℚ.* abs-approx w) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization {sh} (L2 λ) params = map (λ w → λ ℚ.* w) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization {sh} (Dropout p) params = map (λ w → w) (data-vec params)
apply-regularization {sh} (ElasticNet λ1 λ2) params = zipWith (ℚ._+_) 
  (map (λ w → λ1 ℚ.* abs-approx w) (data-vec params))
  (map (λ w → λ2 ℚ.* w) (data-vec params))
